nom: Origins Checks and Balances Gentle Foaming Face Wash

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including perimenopausal dryness and dry patches around the nose and chin, describe the cleanser as calming and non-stripping, with several naming it a go-to for dry or flaky skin.
segments.sensitive: This is the most frequently reported skin type; reviewers with sensitive, rosacea-prone, or eczema-prone skin consistently report no flare-ups, stinging, or new irritation.
segments.combination: Most combination-skin reviewers describe it as balancing oily and dry areas without over-drying, though one combination-skin reviewer found it too drying and recommends it only for very oily skin.
segments.oily: A reviewer with very oily skin reports it cleans thoroughly and controls oil in the T-zone without over-drying.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes her skin as normal and still recommends the cleanser for sensitive skin.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the cleanser leaves skin clean without the tight, stripped feeling of other cleansers; a minority, including one with combination skin, found it left their face dry and dehydrated, particularly around the mouth and nose.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report no new breakouts, including some who mention eczema or active skin issues, and a few explicitly credit it with reducing blemishes or acne.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily areas, including a T-zone and a fully oily complexion, report it removes oil and shine without leaving skin greasy afterward.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers frame it as supportive of a compromised or reactive skin barrier, recommending it for skin dealing with active irritation.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report calmer-looking redness after use, including one with rosacea who found it gentle enough not to aggravate her skin.

aspects.libelle: Cream that whips into a soft foam
Does not fully remove waterproof makeup or mascara
A small amount goes a long way
Can feel tight or drying with frequent use

extraits.texte: This cleanser is gentle and foaming, so it goes on smoothly. I have combination skin and this felt way too drying. It gave my skin a tight squeaky clean feel that made me feel more dehydrated once I was done. I would only recommend this if you have extremely oily skin. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

extraits.titre: Checks And Balances—Gentile Foaming Face Wash
extraits.texte: I've been using the Checks and Balances™ Gentle Foaming Face Wash mostly at night, and it's quickly become one of my favorite gentle cleansers. The texture starts as a cream and transforms into a light, airy foam that feels really soft on my skin. I have dry, sensitive skin, so I'm always cautious with face washes, but this one didn't leave my skin feeling tight or stripped at all. Instead, my face felt clean, balanced, and noticeably softer after each use. I also appreciated the subtle, fresh scent—it's not overpowering, just clean and calming. The blend of ingredients like amino acid cleansers and sunflower seed oil seems to really help maintain hydration while still effectively removing the day's buildup. Overall, it's a great option if you're looking for a gentle but effective daily cleanser. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

extraits.titre: Gent;le, effective and perfect for daily use.
extraits.texte: Since starting perimenopause, my skin has been unpredictable, but the Origins Checks & Balances Gentle Foaming Face Wash has been a total game-changer. I use it both morning and night, and I love how smoothly it applies. The foaming effect is incredibly gentle yet effective, leaving my face feeling thoroughly clean without any tightness. What impressed me most is how it handles my dry patches around my nose and chin; instead of stripping them, it actually helped calm and hydrate those areas. I haven't experienced any breakouts or irritation since I started using it. It's a fantastic, reliable cleanser for anyone dealing with hormonal skin changes. "I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes."

extraits.titre: Great for those with oily skin!
extraits.texte: As someone who has super oily skin, this foaming face wash did a great job of cleaning my skin without making it feel overly dry afterwards and didn't leave any residue like I sometimes get with cream cleansers. I like to doube cleanse, so I use a cleansing oil first, and then a foaming cleanser. As a combo, this left my skin squeaky clean. Also, a little bit goes a long way. I received a deluxe sample of this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes, and I've been using the same little tube for a week!

I have dry, sensitive skin and this cleanser has been a game changer. I use it every morning and my skin feels clean and hydrated without any tightness. The texture is creamy and lathers just enough without feeling harsh. It's also fragrance free which is a huge plus for me. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone with sensitive skin. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

extraits.titre: Works great for combination to sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I've been using this every night for almost three weeks, and my skin hasn't had any irritation or dry patches. I really appreciate how gentle it is and doesn't strip my skin of moisture; it doesn't leave my skin feeling tight after every wash (which I find great!). A little goes a long way! Plus, the fine foams it creates make my skin feel soft, and it hasn't triggered my eczema on the sides of my nose. I love that it has no scent and doesn't leave sticky residue. I would recommend this product if your skin is compromised, you have active skin irritation, or oily skin in the t-zone like me. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. I'm glad I received this product to test out, it was shocking how impressed I was by this cleanser. It was gentle enough to not annoy my sensitive roseaca skin. The texture of this cleanser happens to smooth but textured. It cleans my face and leaves it feeling hydrated
